title: Prevalence and imaging features of temporal bone pneumatization on cone-beam computed tomography: a systematic review and meta-analysis
html: The aim of this systematic review and meta-analysis was to estimate the prevalence of temporal bone pneumatization (TBP), including pneumatization of the articular tubercle (PAT) and glenoid fossa (PGF), based on cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) studies. The laterality, pattern, and extension of the TBP, as well as the sex distribution and age range of the patients are also described. A systematic search was performed in the PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar databases up to May 2025 .
